segments.text: Three sectors could fuel India's next leg of market growth and open new job opportunities. After lagging global markets in 2024, India is now seeing a
revival in growth momentum, better earnings, and stronger policy support.
Goldman expects the nifty to touch 29,000 by end 2026 by 14% upside. But what does this mean for Indian job
seekers? First, financials. With expected rate cuts and rising credit demand, banks and lenders could see stronger earnings, often leading to
hiring in digital banking, risk operations, and lending roles. Second,
automobiles. As rural demand stabilizes and EV adoption rises, both traditional and EV players are preparing for higher volumes. That typically opens jobs in manufacturing, supply chain, servicing,
and dealer networks. Third, consumer discretionary. Urban consumption is improving and demand for appliances and electronics is rising again supporting
hiring in retail, sales, logistics and marketing. If you're positioning for 2025 to 26, these three sectors
financials, autos and consumer discretionary could be the backbone of India's next market rally. Subscribe to
